gate_a_requires: a human running illustrator_gate_a_roundtrip.jsx in Adobe Illustrator and confirming both dialogs
r1_taught_us: R1 passed every automated gate of its own slice and still lost 37 objects in Illustrator. Automated checks constrain the bytes; they do not establish what Illustrator does with them.

r2_source.named_layers_note: R2 is plain EPS, so Illustrator will most likely import it as a single layer. Group and object names are carried as DSC comments and the eight group names are preserved, but Illustrator-native named LAYERS are not guaranteed. Correct stacking and independent editability are what Gate A requires; named layers are a convenience, and trading them for artwork that actually renders is the owner's call to see rather than mine to hide.
